# Nexora Deals

> Nexora Deals is the public discovery layer for verified local offers from Nexora Touch LLC. Visitors can browse without installing an app.

Canonical URL: https://nexora-deals-nail.bitcoinnailbarhousto.chatgpt.site/
Publisher: Nexora Touch LLC
Primary languages: Vietnamese, English, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Korean

## What visitors can find

- Nearby offers organized by location, industry, category, service, price, timing, and availability.
- Coupons with a code or QR, clear terms, expiration, and quantity or redemption limits.
- Last Minute offers tied to a specific open appointment or same-day inventory.
- Deal Match, where a visitor describes a need, budget, time, and one or more areas.
- Upcoming business openings and verified local programs.

## Product relationships

- Nexora Touch is the business operating system where merchants create and manage promotions.
- OneQR is the guest entry point for menus, check-in, booking, services, reviews, tips, rewards, gift cards, and contextual discovery.
- Nexora Deals distributes eligible offers to public discovery surfaces.
- Nexora ID provides account sign-in and optional cross-device synchronization.

## Offer definitions

- Deal: a promotion or banner with no limited coupon inventory.
- Coupon: an offer with a code or QR and a quantity or redemption limit.
- Last Minute: perishable inventory or a specific open time sold close to the time of use.

## Trust and attribution

- Sponsored placements must be labeled.
- Business-created offer terms, availability, pricing, location, and eligibility should be verified before use.
- Nexora Deals is operated by Nexora Touch LLC.
